newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 30 bln lire of Italy 10-yr Btp.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 30 bln lire of Italy 10-yr Btp.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 30 billion lire of 10-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 150 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.2 trillion lire at the open auction for the paper, against 1.5 trillion lire worth of Btps on offer.
The auction price was set at 99.60 from 96.90 at the previous Btp sale on August 29.
